newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Unicorp 6-mo net 27.2 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India's Unicorp 6-mo net 27.2 mln rupees.

text.p: Indian personal computer maker Unicorp Industries Ltd said on Tuesday its net profit for six months ending on March 31 rose to 27.2 million rupees from 13.1 million in the corresponding period in 1995/96.
"The past six months have been very significant for Unicorp Industries Ltd as it has witnessed unprecedented growth," the company said in a statement.
Unicorp said it had recently entered into collaboration with IBM for marketing the U.S. computer giant's systems in India. Unicorp has also tied up with Intel for technology.
The company said it had doubled its production capacity for a range of pentium systems, but gave no details.
